title: All complaints, suggestions of entrepreneurs to be taken into account in Azerbaijan

facts.fact: The Public Council of Azerbaijan's SMB Development Agency aims to address problems of those involved in small and medium businesses, according to its chairman Farhad Garashov.
facts.quote: The purpose of the Public Council is to address problems of those involved in small and medium businesses

facts.fact: Farhad Garashov is Chairman of the Public Council of Azerbaijan's Small and Medium Business (SMB) Development Agency.
facts.quote: Chairman of the Public Council of Azerbaijan's Small and Medium Business (SMB) Development Agency Farhad Garashov told reporters

facts.fact: The Public Council prepared anonymous forms that entrepreneurs can use to submit inquiries, complaints and suggestions.
facts.quote: We have prepared anonymous forms for entrepreneurs, which they can fill in with their inquiries, complaints and suggestions.

facts.fact: Garashov said the Public Council will consider, take into account and respond to each entrepreneur inquiry, complaint and suggestion.
facts.quote: We will certainly consider, take into account and respond to each of them,

facts.fact: A business forum on the current state and prospects of food safety was held in Baku on 23 January (2020).
facts.quote: Baku hosts a business forum on the current state and prospects of food safety on Jan. 23.
